PR09: rebuild the localized plugin composition per language switch

The plugin scenario re-used the scenario's active standard plugin instances
on each language switch and only replaced the localization plugin, which
Plate's composition guard rejects ('must not reuse an active plugin
instance'). Build a complete fresh list - including new PlatePlugins.standard()
instances - per language through an importable composition helper, cached per
language to avoid registry churn on unrelated rebuilds. Add a regression test
that keeps the scenario's standard instances, captures FlutterError.onError,
and asserts the fresh composition commits with the new label.
